cases.name: components
cases.source: for(const c of [new CSSTranslate(CSS.px(10),CSS.px(20)),new CSSTranslate(CSS.px(10),CSS.px(20),CSS.px(0)),new CSSScale(2,3),new CSSScale(2,3,1),new CSSRotate(CSS.deg(90)),new CSSRotate(0,1,0,CSS.deg(90)),new CSSSkew(CSS.deg(10),CSS.deg(20)),new CSSSkewX(CSS.deg(10)),new CSSSkewY(CSS.deg(20)),new CSSPerspective(CSS.px(500)),new CSSPerspective('none'),new CSSMatrixComponent(new DOMMatrix([1,2,3,4,5,6]))])record(c.constructor.name+'|'+String(c)+'|'+c.is2D);

cases.name: mutation
cases.source: const t=new CSSTranslate(CSS.px(3),CSS.px(4));t.z=CSS.px(8);record(String(t)+'|'+t.toMatrix().m43);t.is2D=false;record(String(t)+'|'+t.toMatrix().m43);const r=new CSSRotate(CSS.deg(30));r.x=1;r.y=1;r.z=0;record(String(r));r.is2D=false;record(String(r));for(const c of [new CSSSkewX(CSS.deg(10)),new CSSPerspective(CSS.px(500))]){c.is2D=!c.is2D;record(String(c)+'|'+c.is2D);}

cases.name: matrix
cases.source: const input=new DOMMatrix([1,2,3,4,5,6]);const c=new CSSMatrixComponent(input);record(c.matrix===input);input.e=9;record(c.matrix.e);c.matrix.e=8;record(c.toMatrix().e);c.is2D=false;record(String(c));const list=new CSSTransformValue([new CSSTranslate(CSS.px(10),CSS.px(20)),new CSSScale(2,3)]);record(String(list)+'|'+list.is2D+'|'+list.length);const m=list.toMatrix();record([m.a,m.b,m.c,m.d,m.e,m.f,m.is2D].join('|'));

cases.name: errors
cases.source: for(const f of [()=>new CSSTransformValue([]),()=>new CSSTranslate(CSS.number(1),CSS.px(1)),()=>new CSSTranslate(CSS.px(1),CSS.px(1),CSS.percent(1)),()=>new CSSScale(CSS.percent(50),1),()=>new CSSRotate(CSS.number(0)),()=>new CSSPerspective('auto'),()=>new CSSTranslate(CSS.em(1),CSS.px(0)).toMatrix(),()=>new CSSMatrixComponent({is2D:true})]){try{record(String(f()));}catch(e){record(e.name);}}
